Subject: Q1 Resourcing Committee — prioritization & backfill asks

Hi all,

Ahead of next week's resourcing committee (Wednesday 11/11), I'm sharing the consolidated Q1 headcount requests we received from Engineering, Product, and CS. The ask: review the packet and confirm which reqs we should move to "approve for posting" vs. "defer/hold". We also need quick guidance on the two backfills that were flagged as discretionary.

Key context (high level):
- Hiring budget for Q1 is constrained; we have ~9 FTEs available under current planning.
- Engineering submitted 12 reqs (5 expansion, 7 backfill) with different criticality notes.
- Two roles (Req-417 and Req-422) are tagged as potential freeze candidates depending on SLA risk.

Please see attached: Q1_headcount_requests_v3.xlsx (tabs: summary, by-team, cost-impact) and Req-417-backfill-description.docx. I highlighted recommended priorities in column D of the summary tab.

If you can: 1) mark items you agree to approve, 2) flag any you feel strongly about deferring, and 3) add a one-line rationale in the sheet by EOW Monday. We'll use that to drive the committee decision and the email to People Ops for postings.

Thanks — appreciate a quick pass.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior People Partner, Talent Planning
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q1_headcount_requests_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Req-417-backfill-description.docx (document)]

I'll open the spreadsheet and add preliminary approvals, but want these clarifications so my "approve" picks aren't blind.

Folks — sending the committee outcome and next steps. Thread below contains the internal discussion; summary for People Ops and Acme Procurement is here: 

Summary decisions (committee, 11/09):
- Approve for posting (immediate): Req-409 (Senior PM, Data), Req-413 (SW Eng, Model Serving), Req-426 (Site Reliability Engineer) — 3 reqs approved to post this week.
- Approve for contractor (6 months): Req-417 (Infra backfill) — commit to contractor while we re-evaluate the role in Q2.
- Defer/hold: Req-422 (Support backfill) and remaining expansion requests flagged as low-impact.

Actions: PeopleOps Consulting — please begin job posting process for the three approved reqs and prepare contractor engagement terms for Req-417. Acme Procurement: flagged here because Req-409 is tied to an external vendor renewal we'll notify them once candidate panel is scheduled.

Attachments: Finalized sheet (Q1_headcount_requests_v3.xlsx) with committee marks and a short backfill justification for Req-417.

Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround. I'll run the candidate intake calls after we have job posts live.

Best,
